Here is a 3-4 sentence summary of the article:

Pawan Kalyan, the Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, and his wife Anna Konidala have announced their separation after 13 years of marriage. The couple released a joint statement expressing their decision to part ways with "mutual understanding and respect" and promising to remain good friends. This marks the end of Kalyan's third marriage, following previous divorces in 1999 and 2012. Kalyan is now focusing on his political career, having recently been sworn in as the state's Deputy Chief Minister.
